changelog:
v4.2.0 Major Feature Update:
• Exact Numerical DPI Sensitivity Engine with zero screen shrinkage.
• Input exact Target DPI (550, 720, 960, 1200, 1440, up to 3000 DPI) and Y-Axis Headshot Drag Boost %.
• Live Mathematical DPI multiplier telemetry and in-game sensitivity status.
• 100% preservation of Wolver Touch Guard v4.1.0 (Volume Up+Down unhide shortcut, 6 zones, in-game control menu, 144Hz high refresh rate).
• Permanent release signing key prevents package conflict errors.
